correctness.rationale: Direct valuation argument proves connected cyclic degree-three cover with exactly n simple poles; RH and DS yield genus and ordinarity. All four rational base fibres split, giving the sharp 12-point trigonal count. Castelnuovo–Severi uniqueness controls any arithmetic curve isomorphism, pole-order three obstruction kills nonconstant AS translations, and zero orders force affine changes. Affine stabilizers commute with the length-n Frobenius orbit and hence vanish for gcd(n,6)=1. Möbius irreducible-polynomial count divided by six gives the claimed isomorphism formula. Exact Python checks n=5,7 passed; finite enumeration is not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The numerator is forced naturally by splitting all finite rational fibres and the irreducible denominator enforces a single Frobenius-transitive branch closed point. The result classifies a full arithmetic family of ordinary genus 2n-2 trigonal curves attaining the exact 3(q+1) bound, including a nontrivial isomorphism count and absence of nondeck F3-automorphisms. The structural joint classification, rather than the mere existence or a made-up polynomial slice, is the mathematical contribution.
